title: Memorizu (HKAFF)
synopsis:
Yuta comes to a country town in Kyushu to take care of his father-in-law Makoto, who is recovering from a fractured leg. While helping out with Makoto's old-fashioned photo studio, Yuta exchanges smartphone videos with his wife Yuki and daughter Hana in Tokyo. Between home-cooked meals, daily dog walks and quiet moments scrolling through old photos, the small details of daily life accumulate as a succession of recordings and memories, gently and vividly bringing to light the ongoing existence of their lives as a family.

 

Best New Narrative Director Award, Tribeca Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
雄太來到九州鄉郊，照顧因骨折而行動不便的岳父。他一邊幫忙打理岳父的舊照相館，一邊和留在東京的妻女互傳隨心拍下的影片。做幾道家常便飯、帶柴犬散散步、偶爾看看手機相簿的照片，平凡歲月的生活瑣事看似微不足道，家族的記憶與故事卻在日常間緩緩流淌。新銳導演坂西未郁以樸實鏡頭，娓娓道來一段充滿淡淡溫情的家庭篇章，思索影像與記憶的交織。闊別大銀幕多年的《琳達！琳達！》女星香椎由宇驚喜亮相，拼湊出家族故事的最後一塊拼圖。

 

翠貝卡電影節 最佳劇情片新導演獎

cast: Issey Ogata, Tasuku Emoto, Moeka Hoshi
